headline: Türkiye and Russia Extend Gas Supply Contract and Sign LNG Deal
summary: Gazprom and Turkey's BOTAŞ have extended their natural gas supply contract by three years and signed an LNG supply agreement.
why: Long-term bilateral energy supply agreements secure vital fuel imports for industrial and residential consumption, anchoring regional trade relations.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Contract extensions and LNG supply agreements secure reliable energy inputs for the Turkish economy.
